_comment: Aggregate floors, per surface. Hard-gated safety metrics are not here —
they are per-case and absolute, and live in the case files as gate:hard.
Set from a recorded baseline rather than from ambition. A gate above what
the model in production actually scores fails the shipped system, which
teaches everyone to pass -m 'not eval'. Raise one only with a run behind
it, and say which in the commit message.
tool_selection is 0.90 on purpose: the two hand-run results this project
already recorded were 10/10 and 9/10, and a gate must not retroactively
fail the model that is running today.
skill_recall is 0.65 from measurement. gpt-4o-mini returned NO skills at
all for a posting naming Go and Kubernetes in prose rather than in a
requirements list — a real weakness, recorded rather than tuned away. With
three skill cases one miss moves the mean 33 points, so this number is
noisy; more cases would steady it before it is worth raising.
